notes.title: Demo 1.4.1 Update: Fresh Looks, Skill Revamp, and Better Editor!
notes.notes:
This is likely the last major update before our full release—and it’s packed with exciting changes!

✨ New Look

Brand-new Cubs eye style for a fresh and expressive vibe.

Updated tree art with full collision interaction.

Air walls fade smoother and further, plus toned-down flashy effects.



⚡ Skill Overhaul

Multiple skills reworked with new effects and sounds.

Improved balance and smoother in-game performance.

Switch skills directly inside rooms for faster setup.



🎮 Better Rooms & Editor

Cleaner lobby interface, invite friends without issues.

Map Editor upgraded with an object height slider and more intuitive drag & drop.

Added a new toggle between continuous and single object placement. 



👀 Observer & Gameplay Fixes

Fixed missing visual/camera effects in observer mode.

Improved wall-climbing, start/finish formations, and clearer displacement indicators.



🔊 Audio Improvements

Fixed low volume and synced spectator sounds.

New skill sound effects for more impact!



Jump back in, try the refreshed skills, and check out your Cubs’ new eyes—you’ll feel the difference.
